purpose: Durable session-start, visual-authority, continuity, and sequential-production contract for Vikings 2026 image production.

authority.storyUnit: The exact assembled RexPrompt recipe controls what happens on the current page.
authority.releasedVisualCanon: Released StarSplitterVisions Vikings 2026 material controls established faces, apparent ages, bodies, costumes, locations, props, rendering language, and released story continuity.
authority.currentProduction: Only clearly approved current-production artwork may extend released state. Failed, rejected, repeated, superseded, intake-only, or merely generated images are not continuity authority.
authority.immediateContinuity: The immediately preceding approved page may establish carried state, but it is never the sole identity or style reference.

characterIdentity.primary: Select the clearest released Issue 1 story-art appearance of each recurring character required by the current recipe.
characterIdentity.supplement: Use assembler-visible visualAnchor/performance/promptContinuity fields in data/shows/vikings-2026-s1/characters.json to identify the correct person and prevent redesign.
characterIdentity.rule: Established visual identity is copied from actual released artwork, not recreated from prose.

storyPageLanguage.use: Released Issue 1 ordinary sequential story pages showing the established painted documentary-comedy page language.
exclude: series card, hero, social, logo, or texture assets
storyPageLanguage.rule: Excluded material may support a narrowly scoped identity or world detail when useful, but it is never a story-page layout, header, lettering, or framing template.

currentProduction.rule: An image is not production authority until it is explicitly approved and stored against its exact recipe key.

contentClassLocks.class: municipal editorial or DTI document page
final dossier, credits, case disposition, or CASE CONTINUES page
promotional image with names, handles, labels, title, issue branding, or character callouts

sessionStartGate: Resolve the requested Vikings issue and ordered RexPrompt recipes.
Resolve released Vikings 2026 visual canon from StarSplitterVisions main.
Resolve approved post-release production only from explicit approval evidence and production/drafts/manifest.json.
Build a small working Visual Reference Set from relevant released story art plus approved newer production state.
For each recurring character expected in the next page, include an actual established visual reference whenever one exists.
Do not include cover, editorial, dossier, credits, promotional, labeled, or intake assets as story-page-language references.
Derive the production frontier; never resume from a remembered cursor.
perPageGate: Retrieve or assemble the exact current RexPrompt page recipe.
Verify that the selected page has not already been successfully produced or released.
Identify every recurring character, location, costume, prop, and carried story state required by the recipe.
Select actual released or approved visual references for those recurring elements.
Inspect the immediately preceding approved page when state carries forward.
Generate only after the reference set and immediate continuity are resolved.
Run reader, recipe-fidelity, character-continuity, spatial/prop, visual-language, composition, and lettering checks.
Repair the smallest failing unit and do not advance while the page is defective.
After explicit approval, store the page as the approved production draft for its exact recipe key before relying on it as durable current-production state.

frontierPolicy.rule: The first scripted page not successfully produced is the production frontier. Failed, rejected, repeated, superseded, or unusable generations do not advance it.
frontierPolicy.currentDurableState: No Vikings approved production drafts are currently stored in production/drafts/manifest.json; absent stronger explicit approval evidence, production resumes from the first unresolved Issue 2 recipe rather than from prior failed attempts.

storyPageOutputRule: A normal scripted Vikings story page is a finished full-color portrait comic page in the established Vikings sequential-art language. Do not add a series title, issue header, page label, character name/handle label, dossier frame, municipal form header, credits, promotional callout, or other non-scripted text merely because such elements exist elsewhere in the released issue or promotional material. Only text required by the assembled recipe belongs on the story page.
